title: Hospitalists
description: Provide inpatient care predominantly in settings such as medical wards, acute care units, intensive care units, rehabilitation centers, or emergency rooms. Manage and coordinate patient care throughout treatment.

tasks.text: Diagnose, treat, or provide continuous care to hospital inpatients.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI suggests differentials; clinician examines and owns diagnosis

tasks.text: Prescribe medications or treatment regimens to hospital inpatients.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Prescribing medications is licensed high-stakes judgment

tasks.text: Order or interpret the results of tests such as laboratory tests and radiographs (x-rays).
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Image interpretation assists; radiologist owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Analyze test data or images to inform diagnosis or treatment.
Order medical diagnostic or clinical tests.

tasks.rationale: text generation — Healthcare forms processed digitally; human verifies edge cases

tasks.text: Conduct discharge planning and discharge patients.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Medical plans need exam, liability, and clinical judgment

tasks.text: Write patient discharge summaries and send them to primary care physicians.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Summarize diagnostic and care activities into reports

dwas.name: Prepare reports summarizing patient diagnostic or care activities.
Inform medical professionals regarding patient conditions and care.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Refer patients to medical specialists, social services, or other professionals as appropriate.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Clinical referral judgment needs licensed human accountability

dwas.name: Refer patients to other healthcare practitioners or health resources.

tasks.text: Direct, coordinate, or supervise the patient care activities of nursing or support staff.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient care supervision is live clinical leadership

tasks.text: Attend inpatient consultations in areas of specialty.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI summarizes medical updates; human retains judgment

tasks.text: Communicate with patients' primary care physicians upon admission, when treatment plans change, or at discharge to maintain continuity and quality of care.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Clinical handoff carries accountability and nuance

dwas.name: Inform medical professionals regarding patient conditions and care.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Participate in continuing education activities to maintain or enhance knowledge and skills.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI summarizes medical updates; human retains judgment

tasks.text: Direct or support quality improvement projects or safety programs.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Compliance coordination needs human accountability and site action

dwas.name: Coordinate safety or regulatory compliance activities.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Direct the operations of short stay or specialty units.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Healthcare operations accountability and staffing are human

tasks.text: Train or supervise medical students, residents, or other health professionals.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Provider training is clinical, hands-on, accountable
